arxiv-2004-08051.title: AIRL from Vision-based Imitation Learning
arxiv-2004-08051.creator: Keuntaek Lee, Bogdan Vlahov, Jason Gibson, James M. Rehg, Evangelos A. Theodorou
arxiv-2004-08051.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Keuntaek Lee, Bogdan Vlahov, Jason Gibson, James M. Rehg, Evangelos A. Theodorou. In this work, we present a method for obtaining an implicit objective function for vision-based navigation. The proposed methodology relies on Imitation Learning, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and an interpretation technique used in Deep Neural Networks. We use Imitation Learning as a means to do Inverse Reinforcement Learning in order to create an approximate cost function generator for a visual navigation challenge.

arxiv-2012-07125.title: Magnetoexcitons in transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers, bilayers, and van der Waals heterostructures
arxiv-2012-07125.creator: Roman Ya. Kezerashvili 1,2 and Anastasia Spiridonova 1,2
arxiv-2012-07125.description: Abstract We study direct and indirect magnetoexcitons in Rydberg states in monolayers and heterostructures of transition metal dichalcogenices (TMDCs) in an external magnetic field, applied perpendicular to the monolayer or heterostructures in the framework of a Mott-Wannier model of excitons.

arxiv-2107-06424.title: Tourbillon: a Physically Plausible Neural Architecture
arxiv-2107-06424.creator: Mohammadamin Tavakoli, Peter Sadowski, Pierre Baldi
arxiv-2107-06424.description: Abstract In a physical neural system, backpropagation is faced with a number of obstacles including: the need for labeled data, the violation of the locality learning principle, the need for symmetric connections, and the lack of modularity. Tourbillon is a new architecture that addresses all these limitations.

arxiv-2210-01743.title: Covariance Steering of Discrete-Time Linear Systems with Mixed Multiplicative and Additive Noise
arxiv-2210-01743.creator: Isin M. Balci, Efstathios Bakolas
arxiv-2210-01743.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Isin M. Balci, Efstathios Bakolas. In this paper, we study the covariance steering (CS) problem for discrete-time linear systems subject to multiplicative and additive noise. Specifically, we consider two variants of the so-called CS problem. The goal of the first problem, which is called the exact CS problem, is to steer the mean and the covariance of the state process to their desired values in finite time.

arxiv-2302-09361.title: Analysis of Many-body Localization Landscapes and Fock Space Morphology via Persistent Homology
arxiv-2302-09361.creator: Gregory A. Hamilton, Bryan K. Clark
arxiv-2302-09361.description: Abstract We analyze functionals that characterize the distribution of eigenstates in Fock space through a tool derived from algebraic topology: persistent homology. Drawing on recent generalizations of the localization landscape applicable to mid-spectrum eigenstates, we introduce several novel persistent homology observables in the context of many-body localization that exhibit transitional behavior near the critical point.

arxiv-2310-12489.title: Me dAI Di alog C orpus (MEDIC): Zero-Shot Classification of Doctor and AI Responses in Health Consultations
arxiv-2310-12489.creator: Olumide E. Ojo, Olaronke O. Adebanji, Alexander Gelbukh, Hiram Calvo, Anna Feldman
arxiv-2310-12489.description: Abstract Zero-shot classification enables text to be classified into classes not seen during training. In this study, we examine the efficacy of zero-shot learning models in classifying healthcare consultation responses from Doctors and AI systems. The models evaluated include BART, BERT, XLM, XLM-R and DistilBERT.

arxiv-2406-17383.title: Hybrid Classical-Quantum Simulation of MaxCut using QAOA-in-QAOA Thanks: * Equal Contribution
arxiv-2406-17383.creator: Aniello Esposito*, Tamuz Danzig*
arxiv-2406-17383.description: Abstract The Quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is a leading hybrid classical-quantum algorithm for solving complex combinatorial optimization problems. QAOA-in-QAOA (QAOA 2 ) uses a divide-and-conquer heuristic to solve large-scale Maximum Cut (MaxCut) problems, where many sub-graph problems can be solved in parallel.

arxiv-2410-21646.title: The Quadratic and Cubic Characters of 2
arxiv-2410-21646.creator: Matias C. Relyea
arxiv-2410-21646.description: Abstract . The solvability of the cubic congruence x 3 ≡ 2 ( mod p ) x^{3}\equiv 2\pmod{p} is referred to as the cubic character of 2 . In evaluating the cubic character of 2, we introduce the Eisenstein integers, Gauss and Jacobi sums, and the law of cubic reciprocity.

arxiv-2511-07611.title: On the combinatorics of tableaux — Classification of lattices underlying Schensted correspondences
arxiv-2511-07611.creator: Dale R. Worley
arxiv-2511-07611.description: Abstract . The celebrated Robinson–Schensted algorithm and each of its variants that have attracted substantial attention can be constructed using Fomin’s “growth diagram” construction from a modular lattice that is also a weighted-differential poset. We classify all such lattices that meet certain criteria; the main criterion is that the lattice is distributive.

arxiv-2511-13751.title: Inside VOLT: Designing an Open-Source GPU Compiler
arxiv-2511-13751.creator: Shinnung Jeong, Chihyo Ahn, Huanzhi Pu, Jisheng Zhao, Hyesoon Kim, Blaise Tine
arxiv-2511-13751.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shinnung Jeong, Chihyo Ahn, Huanzhi Pu, Jisheng Zhao, Hyesoon Kim, Blaise Tine. Recent efforts in open-source GPU research are opening new avenues in a domain that has long been tightly coupled with a few commercial vendors. Emerging open GPU architectures define SIMT functionality through their own ISAs, but executing existing GPU programs and optimizing performance on these ISAs relies on a compiler framework that is technically complex and often undercounted in open-hardware development costs.

arxiv-2511-14677.title: Equilateral non-Gaussian Bias at the Field Level Preprint: MIT-CTP/5956
arxiv-2511-14677.creator: Divij Sharma, James M. Sullivan, Kazuyuki Akitsu, Mikhail M. Ivanov
arxiv-2511-14677.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Divij Sharma, James M. Sullivan, Kazuyuki Akitsu, Mikhail M. Ivanov. Primordial non-Gaussianity (PNG) is a common prediction of a wide class of inflationary models. Equilateral-type PNG, generically predicted by single-field inflationary models with higher-derivative interactions, imprints subtle but measurable signatures on the large-scale distribution of matter. An important parameter of these imprints is the PNG-induced bias coefficient b ψ b_{\psi} , which quantifies how the abundance and clustering of dark matter halos and galaxies respond to mode coupling in the initial conditions.

arxiv-2601-17108.title: MambaNet: Mamba-assisted Channel Estimation Neural Network With Attention Mechanism
arxiv-2601-17108.creator: Dianxin Luan 1 , Chengsi Liang 2 , Jie Huang 3 4 , Zheng Lin 5 , Kaitao Meng 6 , John Thompson 1 and Cheng - Xiang Wang 3 4
arxiv-2601-17108.description: Abstract This paper proposes a Mamba-assisted neural network framework incorporating self-attention mechanism to achieve improved channel estimation with low complexity for orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) waveforms, particularly for configurations with a large number of subcarriers. With the integration of customized Mamba architecture, the proposed framework handles large-scale subcarrier channel estimation efficiently while capturing long-distance dependencies among these subcarriers effectively.

arxiv-2602-08288.title: Probing α \alpha clustering in C 12 {}^{12}\mathrm{C} at CSR energies using the Jet AA Microscopic Transport Model
arxiv-2602-08288.creator: Subhash Singha
arxiv-2602-08288.description: Abstract We investigate the sensitivity of low-energy nuclear collisions to intrinsic nuclear structure by studying the interplay between initial-state geometry and final-state observables in C+C and C+Pb collisions at s NN = 2.36 \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=2.36 GeV, relevant for experiments at the Cooling Storage Ring (CSR) facility in Lanzhou and forthcoming experiments at the High Intensity heavy-ion Accelerator Facility (HIAF) in Huizhou.

arxiv-2606-28314.creator: Om Gupta, Pawan Kumar, Paz Beniamini, Edward L. Robinson

britannica-1911-penza-town.title: Penza (town) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-penza-town.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-penza-town.description: Article 'Penza (town)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. above the sea, at the confluence of the Penza with the navigable Sura. The older parts of the town are constructed of wood, but the newer parts are well built. The cathedral was erected in 1820–1821. Penza has technical schools, public libraries, a museum of antiquities, and a theatre which has played some part in the history of the Russian stage.

britannica-1911-rochambeau-jean-baptiste.title: Rochambeau, Jean Baptiste Donatien de Vimeur (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-rochambeau-jean-baptiste.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-rochambeau-jean-baptiste.description: Article 'Rochambeau, Jean Baptiste Donatien de Vimeur' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In 1757 and 1758 he fought in Germany, notably at Crefeld, received several wounds in the battle of Clostercamp (1760), was appointed maréchal de camp in 1761 and inspector of cavalry and was frequently consulted by the ministers on technical points.

pmc-11335491.title: Tumor necrosis factor inhibitors enhance corticosteroid therapy for Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis linked to immune checkpoint inhibitors: a prospective study
pmc-11335491.creator: Chun-Xia He, Lan Guo, Tao Qu, Hong-Zhong Jin
pmc-11335491.description: IntroductionImmune-related epidermal necrolysis (irEN), including Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) and toxic epidermal necrolysis (TEN), represents a potentially lethal reaction to immune checkpoint inhibitors. An optimal treatment strategy remains undefined. This study evaluates the effectiveness and safety of combination therapy with corticosteroids and tumor necrosis factor inhibitors (TNFi) in treating irEN patients.

pmc-11493072.title: Kinematic characterization of backhand stroke accuracy in squash based on kinematic variables between two different skill levels—a preliminary cross-sectional study
pmc-11493072.creator: Rui Huang, Haojie Li, Jian Jiang, Zhitao Zhou, Chen Xiu
pmc-11493072.description: BackgroundThe aim of this study was to compare differences in shot placement and accuracy between national and international level squash players. Squash is a technically demanding sport and understanding the biomechanical characteristics of athletes at different levels is important for developing effective training strategies.

pmc-12463586.title: Primary lung cancer with duodenal metastasis complicated by obstructive jaundice and pancreatitis: a case report
pmc-12463586.creator: Jie Kuang, Yanan Chen, Huikang Xie, Hua Hao, Yanlin Zhao, Cui Tang
pmc-12463586.description: BackgroundPrimary lung adenocarcinoma with duodenal metastasis is relatively rare, and its early clinical symptoms are often insidious, making diagnosis challenging. CT, MR, PET-CT, and gastroscopy can effectively identify gastrointestinal metastatic lesions, providing reliable evidence for definitive diagnosis and treatment planning, which contributes to prolonging patient survival.Case presentationThis report presents a rare case of duodenal metastasis from lung adenocarcinoma.

pmc-12595926.title: Bibliometric Analysis of Immigrants’ Health Education: Research Status, Evolution, and Trends with CiteSpace
pmc-12595926.creator: Jianyi Li, Zejun Wei
pmc-12595926.description: BackgroundImmigrants’ health education (IHE) plays a critical role in improving the health status of immigrant populations, reducing public health risks, and promoting social integration. Over the past decade, IHE has emerged as a prominent research topic, with numerous studies exploring its specific characteristics; however, comprehensive overviews remain scarce.

pmc-12691949.title: ESR1 Regulates Fecundity and Functions in Sheep Endometrial Stromal Cells
pmc-12691949.creator: Kang Li, Xiaoxiao Gao, Zhibo Wang, Dongxu Li, Jiahe Guo, Feng Wang, Tianlong Guo, Kamil Gill
pmc-12691949.description: Endometrial stromal cell (ESC) plasticity is critical to embryo survival and conceptus elongation; however, their genetic regulation remains unclear. To elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which ESR1 regulates sheep fecundity through endometrial function, we investigated the effects of ESR1 on ovine ESCs in vitro.

pmc-12836456.title: Liver Cirrhosis With Encapsulating Peritoneal Sclerosis: A Case Report
pmc-12836456.creator: Emery Boudreau, Rosemarie Matte, Christian Wilke
pmc-12836456.description: A 72-year-old male with a history of alcohol use disorder complicated by cirrhosis and chronic thrombocytopenia, hypertension, chronic back pain, a congenital solitary kidney, and active tobacco use presented with a one-year history of intermittent right upper quadrant pain. Preoperative evaluation suggested symptomatic cholelithiasis, and he was brought to the operating room for laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

pmc-12992996.title: The involvement of anaesthetists and other healthcare professionals with surgeons in shared decision-making for adult patients contemplating surgery: a systematic review and narrative analysis
pmc-12992996.creator: Nisha Sriram, Andreana Glendinning, Timothy J Stephens, Gemma Hughes
pmc-12992996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundRecognising the medical and surgical complexity of certain patient populations, perioperative pathways are evolving to incorporate multidisciplinary team perspectives, alongside surgeons, in shared decision-making. pmc-13379844.title: Analysis of Caesarean Deliveries (CD) at a Tertiary Hospital in Northeastern Nigeria: A 5 Year Review.
pmc-13379844.creator: Umaru Inuwa, Maisaratu A. Bakari, Mohammed T. Kaitafi, Saidu Kadas
pmc-13379844.description: BackgroundOne of the most commonly performed surgical procedures in Obstetrics is caesarean delivery (CD), and certainly the oldest surgical operation. Caesarean delivery is life-saving, especially when there is a failure or contraindication to vaginal delivery. However, the health risk and the cost of the surgery may be quite challenging, especially in low-resource countries like Nigeria.

pmc-13562806.title: Integrating the Health Belief Model and the Theory of Planned Behavior to Decode Willingness to Pay for Cancer Screening: Evidence From Community‐Based Cross‐Sectional Surveys in China
pmc-13562806.creator: Jianwei Wang, Shuangshuang Cao, Xingzhou Wang, Jiaojiao Li, Zhongli Wang, Gaopei Zhu, Fuzhong Xue
pmc-13562806.description: BackgroundWillingness to pay for cancer screening has been widely adopted to examine barriers to screening. This study integrated the Health Belief Model and the Theory of Planned Behavior to explore the correlational pathways linked to WTP‐CS among Chinese community‐dwelling residents.MethodsA multistage stratified survey was carried out in a cancer early screening demonstration zone.

pmc-13584019.title: Measuring and understanding geographic inequities in physician distribution in the Philippines: a multi-method study protocol
pmc-13584019.creator: Veincent Christian F Pepito, Ryan Gabriel C Molen, Julius R Migriño, Theo Prudencio Juhani Z Capeding, Ann Rose D Payumo, Hazel Ivy M Jeremias, Karl R Ubial, William C Tiu, Manuel M Dayrit
